description: The ts-openapi block: documents that golem reads from controller sources.

docs.description: The documents to write, one job for each entry.

framework.description: The controller framework. Only nestjs is known, and it is the default.

root.description: The folder that the job scans for controllers. The default is the folder of golem.yaml.

sources.description: Controller files. The job reads these and no others.

suffixes.description: File-name endings of a controller file. Each starts with a dot and ends in .ts, .mts or .cts. The default is .controller.ts.

output.description: The OpenAPI document to write: a JSON or YAML file.

openapiVersion.description: The OpenAPI version of the document.

securitySchemes.description: Named OpenAPI security schemes that controller metadata references.

globalPrefix.description: A prefix for every route. Match the application configuration.

uriVersioning.description: URI versioning. Set it when controllers declare versions.

maxResultBytes.description: The most bytes of JSON that a route path or version can fold to. The default is 1048576.
